locations.title: Albert Wesker
locations.description:
**Reward:** [Heart of Africa](#loc=899211)

Has seven minutes to play with you.

**Tips:**
- Go through the [Blocked Door](#loc=899184) and extinguish some fires
- When Wesker can't see you, land some shots (if he staggers, rush in for a bunch of quick time events and a big melee combo!)
- If you have a rocket launcher, he'll catch the rocket - but you can shoot to blow it up while he's struggling for massive damage.

locations.title: Albert Wesker, Again
locations.description:
**Reward:** [Finale](#loc=899512)

**Tips:**
- Use levers around the arena to turn off the lights
- When Wesker can't see you, land some shots (if he staggers, rush in for a bunch of quick time events and a big melee combo!)
- Use the rocket launcher - he'll catch the rockets, but you can shoot to blow them up while he's struggling for massive damage.
- Stay close - one person will need to restrain him, and the other will inject him. There's not much time for it, so act fast!
- You'll find more rockets [here](#loc=899507).

locations.description:
**How to Solve:**
- Turn [Mirror 3](#loc=898912) as seen in the first screenshot
- Turn [Mirror 4](#loc=898913) as seen in the second screenshot
- Turn [Mirror 5](#loc=898914) as seen in the third screenshot to unlock the side-rooms

- Turn [Mirror 6](#loc=898925) as seen in the fourth screenshot
- Turn [Mirror 5](#loc=898914) as seen in the third screenshot to power the elevator

From your starting point, use the Grenade Launcher or a Rocket Launcher to shoot at the rocks in the screenshot. After a rock bridge collapses beneath you, you'll find the treasure has landed [here](#loc=899518), where you can jump across the rock you blew up to reach it.

**Sell Price:** 5,000
